jobs.title: Principal Developer (a)
jobs.description:
Die Prämisse: Code ist kein Asset, Code ist Liability.

Wir suchen keinen Entwickler, der stolz auf die Anzahl seiner geschriebenen Zeilen ist. Wir suchen einen Architekten, der versteht, dass Vibe Coding (nach Karpathy u.a.) die Abstraktionsebene fundamental verschoben hat. Deine Arbeitseinheit ist nicht mehr die Funktion, sondern der Agentic Workflow.

In unserem Legal-Compliance-Umfeld ist Qualität nicht verhandelbar. Deine Aufgabe ist es, probabilistische Coding-Agents (LLMs) so zu orchestrieren, dass sie deterministische, auditsichere Software für .NET und React liefern.

Der Tech Stack & Die Toolchain 

Wir operieren am „Bleeding Edge“ der Produktivität. Du bringst dein eigenes AI-Setup mit oder definierst unseres neu.

  • Infrastructure: Terraform 

  • Core: .NET 9/10, React (TypeScript).

  • Data: MS-SQL (als System of Record)

  • Deine Werkzeuge: Du arbeitest täglich mit Tools wie Claude Code,  Cursor, Windsurf und probierst auch gerne Neue aus 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Die KI schreibt den Boilerplate, du löst die Hard Problems des Vibe Codings

  • Du entwickelst Lösungen & Strategien die helfen, Halluzinationen in der Business-Logik (C#) mathematisch auszuschließen.

  • Du optimierst das „Working Memory“ deiner Coding-Agenten, sodass Datenbankschemata und legacy Code nutzbar sind, ohne den Kontext zu sprengen.

  • Du verhinderst, dass die Infrastructure sich unbemerkt vom Soll-Zustand entfernt, wenn deine Agenten autonom Terraform-Skripte anpassen

  • Du findest elegante und effektive Wege, KI-generierten Code zu reviewen und das “human-in-the-loop-bottleneck” so groß wie möglich zu machen


Dein Profil

  • Du bist ein Alter Hase in .NET und React und erkennst Anti-Patterns, bevor der Linter anschlägt

  • Du hast ein tiefes und breites Verständnis von Softwarearchitektur, Patterns und ihren jeweiligen Vor- und Nachteilen

  • Du du denkst in Rules und Chain-of-Thought-Vorgaben, die sichern, dass KI unseren Guidelines und Sicherheitsstandards folgt.

  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team und genießt es, im SCRUM gemeinsam anzupacken

  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und erfahren darin, in diversen Teams deine Stärken mit denen deiner KollegInnen zu verbinden

Deine Benefits

  • Flexibilität: Arbeite im Gleitzeitmodell im Büro und Homeoffice

  • Weiterentwicklung: Du bekommst ein persönliches Mentoring, individuelle Sprachtrainings und regelmäßige Coachings

  • Sonderurlaub: Extra-Tag für freiwilliges soziales Engagement

  • Edenred-Karte: Monatliches Guthaben für flexible Nutzung bei vielen Partnern

  • Familienservice: Unterstützung bei Kinderbetreuung & familiären Anliegen durch pme Familienservice

  • Gesundheit: Wir fördern Deine Gesundheit mit Meditationsapps, Fitnessangeboten, Jobrad, ergonomischen Büros uvm.

  • Altersvorsorge: Wir tragen bis zu 20% zu Deiner Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksamen Leistungen bei

  • Weitere Benefits findest du hier: Jetzt Benefits entdecken


    Wir l(i)eben Vielfalt – bei Eticor heißen wir jeden herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion oder anderen Merkmalen. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung und darauf, gemeinsam mit Dir die Zukunft zu gestalten.

jobs.title: Nix / NixOS Software Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
atvari is a technology company specializing in software and cloud architecture, custom software engineering, cloud engineering, DevOps, and IT consulting. The team is passionate about building robust, modern solutions with a strong focus on Rust, Nix, and open-source technologies. atvari values clean, maintainable code and collaborative engineering practices. Applicants can expect to work in an environment that encourages learning, experimentation, and contribution to the open-source community.

Tasks

Role Description

As a Nix / NixOS Software Engineering Intern at atvari, you will support the design, implementation, and maintenance of Nix-based development and deployment environments. You will assist in writing and refining Nix and NixOS configurations, automating build and deployment workflows, and integrating Nix with existing software projects. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with engineers on backend services, troubleshooting environment and dependency issues, and documenting configuration and tooling. This is a fully remote internship, where you will work closely with the engineering team and gain hands-on experience with Rust, Nix, and cloud-native practices.

Internship Details

This is an unpaid internship for the duration of 1-3 months based on your needs. It is either offered as a voluntary internship (Freiwilliges Praktikum) or a mandatory internship (Pflichtpraktikum) and it is only available to German residents.

You are eligible if one of these conditions apply to you:

  • you do not have a completed apprenticeship or university degree (Freiwilliges Praktikum)
  • you need a mandatory internship as part of a degree program (Pflichtpraktikum)

Requirements

  • Strong foundational knowledge in Computer Science, including algorithms, data structures, and operating systems.
  • Exposure to Software Development and Programming, with experience in at least one high-level language (Rust experience is a plus).
  • Understanding of Back-End Web Development concepts, such as APIs, microservices, and server-side frameworks.
  • Familiarity with Functional Programming (FP) principles and their practical application in codebases.
  • Interest in Nix / NixOS, reproducible builds, DevOps, and infrastructure as code.
  • Ability to learn quickly, work in a team setting, and communicate clearly about technical topics.
  • Comfort working remotely in Germany and collaborating in a cross-functional engineering environment.

Benefits

Our Tech Stack

  • Nix / NixOS
  • Rust
  • TypeScript & React
  • Kubernetes & Podman
  • OpenTofu / Terraform
  • gRPC, Protobuf & buf
  • GraphQL
  • Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Mimir
  • OpenTelemetry
  • WebAssembly
  • OpenCode & Claude Code
  • GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo
  • Hetzner Cloud, GCP, AWS, Azure, OpenStack

Other tools we use:

jobs.title: Panel Manager (f/m/d) - Freelancer / Contractor; 100% remote possible
jobs.description:
Panel Manager (f/m/d)

📍 Location: Remote (No Relocation)
💼 Employment Type: Contractor / Freelance ; 3 to 6 months contract

About PlaytestCloud

PlaytestCloud’s Player Insights Platform™ helps game studios improve their games through feedback from real players. Over 60% of the top-grossing game studios have tested their games with PlaytestCloud.

🏆 Premier provider for games. We help game studios worldwide make the best games they possibly can. 

🏆 Built for player insight. We build technology that enables secure, high-quality remote game testing. 

🏆 Independent and established. We are bootstrapped and profitable, with more than 400 paying game studios and over one million playtesters.

Our player community

PlaytestCloud runs one of the largest proprietary player panels in games: a large, growing, global community of players who take part because they care about making the games they play better. 

This isn't a role where you're building a panel from scratch. You'll be advising a mature Research Operations team that's already investing in the long-term health, quality, and strategic development of that community. 

Our goal is simple: help game studios make better decisions through real player insight. You'll play a central role in keeping that community trusted, representative, engaged, and ready for what game developers need next.

About the role

We're hiring an experienced, analytical Panel Manager (f/m/d) to shape the next stage of PlaytestCloud's proprietary player panel. Your job: figure out what makes a panel strong and scalable, then turn that understanding into measurable action. You'll identify the metrics that matter most, find opportunities to improve panel quality and availability, and build a practical framework that helps us serve studios better as we grow. This is a freelance contract (3–6 months) with a clear mission: build a stronger foundation for how we measure, manage, and grow our player panel.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Panel strategy and ownership. Take ownership of the health and growth of PlaytestCloud's global player panel.

  • Metrics and insight. Define and track the metrics that connect panel performance, player experience, studio needs, and business growth.

  • Opportunity identification. Analyze panel data to find the highest-impact opportunities, constraints, and risks.

  • Actionable improvements. Turn insight into practical recommendations, and work with the right teams to implement and measure them.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Partner closely with Research Operations, Product, and GTM to make sure the panel supports great outcomes for our studios.

  • Sustainable foundations. Set up a reporting rhythm, performance framework, and roadmap the team can keep using after the contract ends.


Your profile

Must-have:

  • Panel experience. Recent hands-on experience managing, running, growing, or optimizing a large participant panel, research-participant community, or gaming community — including participant supply, retention, quality, segmentation, and/or incentive strategy. 

  • Commercial and analytical mindset. You know how to find the few metrics that actually matter, connect them to customer and business outcomes, and use data to make good calls. 

  • Tool competency. Comfortable querying databases in SQL, and familiar with agentic AI tools like Claude or Codex. 

  • Ownership. You're a self-starter who likes taking on an ambiguous challenge, building structure around it, and driving it forward on your own. 

  • Practical problem-solving. You turn analysis into clear priorities and action, not insight for its own sake. 

  • Strong communication. You can explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical people alike. 

  • Strong English. Comfortable communicating in written and spoken English on a remote, international team.

Great to have:

  • Qualitative research experience. Experience supporting or working closely with qualitative user research, including participant recruitment, study operations, interviews, usability testing, or research synthesis.

  • Games and player research. Interest in games, player research, or the gaming industry. Direct games-recruitment experience is not required.

Get in touch with us

Questions about the role or our hiring process? Email our Talent team at talent[at]playtestcloud.com.

AI-gestützte Entwicklung verstehen wir nicht als Ersatz für technisches Können: Entscheidend ist, dass du mit Coding Agents schneller zu guten Ergebnissen kommst und deren Resultate fachlich beurteilen kannst.

jobs.description:
